plugin.name: Advanced Timer
plugin.description: Professional multi-timer system with event automation and customizable overlays

modes.countdown: Countdown - Count down from a time
modes.countup: Count Up - Count up to a target

messages.confirmDelete: Are you sure you want to delete this timer?
messages.quickStart: Create a timer and configure events in the timer settings to add time based on TikTok events (gifts, likes, follows, etc.)

help.modesCountdown: Countdown: Counts down from a starting time to zero
help.modesCountup: Count Up: Counts up from zero to a target value
help.modesInterval: Interval: Counts up to target, resets and repeats
help.eventAutomationDesc: Configure timers to respond to TikTok events:
help.eventGifts: Gifts - Add/remove time based on coin value (seconds per coin)
help.eventLikes: Likes - Modify timer based on likes received (seconds per like)
help.eventChat: Chat Commands - Allow viewers to interact
help.timerChainsDesc: Link timers together - when Timer A completes, automatically start/stop/reset Timer B
help.overlaysDesc: Each timer has its own overlay URL that can be added as a Browser Source in OBS

settings.eventsDesc: Configure how TikTok events affect this timer
settings.overlayInfo: Add this URL as a Browser Source in OBS to display this timer

rotator.sectionDesc: Shows the most recent time-delta around the timer (top/bottom/left/right). Custom gifts display the gift GIF from the catalog.

thresholdEffects.sectionDesc: When a single time-delta exceeds the threshold, the timer is wrapped in a frame/animation. Use a built-in style, upload your own, or both.
thresholdEffects.frameSlotsTitle: Custom frame slots (upload up to 6 PNG/WebP/GIF/SVG — shown round-robin):
